creators.story: Jimmy Donaldson built MrBeast from years of experimentation into one of YouTube's biggest creator brands.
facts: MrBeast operates multiple major YouTube channels.
The brand has expanded into products, food and other businesses.
His early uploads covered gaming, commentary and experiments before the channel became known for huge challenges.
timeline: Early years — experimented with different kinds of YouTube videos.
2017 — gained major attention from viral challenge content.
Late 2010s — scaled production and philanthropy-focused videos.
2020s — expanded into multiple channels and businesses.

creators.story: Mark Rober combined engineering with entertaining storytelling to make complex science accessible to a huge audience.
facts: Before becoming a full-time creator, Rober worked as an engineer at NASA.
His videos commonly turn an engineering problem into a large experiment.
He has built projects designed to teach science through entertainment.
timeline: Engineering career — worked on projects including NASA's Curiosity rover.
2011 — began publishing science and engineering videos.
2020s — expanded science education projects and collaborations.

creators.story: Marques Brownlee started making technology videos as a teenager and grew MKBHD into a major technology media brand.
facts: He began making technology videos while still in school.
MKBHD comes from his initials and the letters HD.
His work expanded beyond reviews into podcasts and interviews.
timeline: Early 2010s — grew through reviews and tutorials.
Late 2010s — expanded production and interview-focused content.
2020s — continued growing MKBHD into a broader media brand.

creators.story: Felix Kjellberg built a huge audience through gaming commentary and personality-driven videos, becoming one of the defining creators of the 2010s.
facts: The channel originally focused heavily on gaming commentary.
His content changed genres several times as YouTube and his audience evolved.
PewDiePie became one of the most recognizable creator brands of the 2010s.
timeline: Early 2010s — rapidly grew through gaming commentary.
2013 — became the most-subscribed YouTube channel for a period.
Later years — diversified content beyond gaming.
